metadataReview.note: Add a village-sector reference for the action of 15 January 1895 at Senafé, where the Enciclopedia Italiana places the Tigrayan camp shelled by the pursuing Italian column; the 1911 Britannica also names Senafé. The existing date is retained and no end date is added. Casualty figures in these sources are not adopted. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The Enciclopedia Italiana entry Coatit states that on the evening of 15 January 1895 the pursuing Italian column reached the northern edge of the Senafè basin, in sight of the Tigrayan force camped in the basin near the village, and that the Ciccodicola battery shelled the camp from near Amba Tericà. The OpenStreetMap gazetteer node for the town of Senafe (node 321223133, place=town, resolved through Nominatim) gives latitude 14.7017550 and longitude 39.4243820, rounded to [39.4244,14.7018]. This is a village-sector reference for the camp area, not the Amba Tericà battery position or a surveyed camp location. No accuracy radius is claimed.
